headline: Club Penguin closed on March 30, 2017.
slides: Club Penguin launched: penguins, igloos, puffles and a lot of dancing.
Disney bought it for a reported $700 million.
At one point it reportedly had around 200 million registered users.
Disney announced the original would close, replaced by a mobile app.
The servers shut down at 12:01am Pacific.
Fan-run copies kept it alive, until Disney had many taken down.
